newsitem.title: USA: Applied Analytical sees research aiding net.
newsitem.headline: Applied Analytical sees research aiding net.

text.p: Applied Analytical Industries Inc said it expects a positive impact on its future earnings due to its increased research and development spending and the approval of its new products.

Frederick Sancilio, chairman and chief executive officer, said, "Research and development spending increased 86 percent over the comparable prior year period . . . we believe that future earnings will be positively impacted by this increased R & D investment."

The company also said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved its ANDA for an ophthalmic product and its German subsidiary received marketing approval for a generic nifedipine sustained release product.

In addition, the company said it is expecting approval of a client's hormone replacement therapy product which could generate contract-manufacturing revenues commencing in the second half of this year.

Finally, during the second quarter, the company said it completed negotiations for a service contract with anticipated revenues of approximately $20 million which should significantly contribute to revenues during the next 18 months.

Applied Analytical contracts research and development for the pharmaceutical and biotech industries, develops products, provides support services worldwide and licenses internally developed drugs and drug technologies to others.
